calibration_status: CAD-derived slit location and full front aperture; real sensor mounting and slit dimensions unverified
mount_rationale: At panel-local z=0.205 m, a robot-forward optical origin x=0.17991 m gives a 180.00-degree CAD slit opening at 0.01-degree probe resolution. The +/-90-degree edge-ray clearance threshold is x=0.1798967 m. The optical point is 27.09 mm behind the outer front surface at x=0.207 m. Moving 1 mm inward narrows the opening to about 178.8 degrees; 1 mm outward widens it to about 181.2 degrees. The visible point marks the optical origin, not an external sensor body.
